display_name: Income Tax Ordinance, earlier vintages: s 66(c)(4)-(6) before 2024 (credit points for children; declined by name except the tax year 2022 addition of Act SH 2972, and answered from 2024 by the Acts' own words) and s 121B for tax year 2025 (Act SH 3342, amendment 276: the additional tax, with the new (a1))

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Hebrew is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the deposited consolidation, in `-- act:` comments read from the Acts' page images and checked against their text layers (tools/actcheck.py), and in subsection labels.

source.authority: aid: unofficial Hebrew Wikisource consolidation, as amended at retrieval; the enacting Acts below are authoritative

scope: Encoded: s 66(c)(4), (4A), (5), (6): the vintage that governs a tax year; from tax year 2024 the credit points the Acts' words give a child by age, for the woman, the woman who married a widower, the man and the man who married a widow, before the (4)(a1) election; for tax year 2022 the further credit point of Act SH 2972 only (as an addition to a base the sources do not hold), with the age limit of thirteen years as a switch declining for a child born in 2009. s 121B for tax year 2025: (a), (a1), (b), (d) as an input convention, (e) with both definitions, with the (a) amount supplied and the residential threshold at 5,385,285. Not encoded: s 66(a), (b), (c)(1)-(3), (d) before 2024, s 40 in any vintage, the work-grant provisions, s 121B before 2025 and from 2026 (row IL-03). See NOTES.md sections 1-3.

tax_years_answered.s 66(c)(4)-(6): 2024 onward by the Acts' own words, before the (4)(a1) election (which row IL-02 encodes); tax year 2022: the further credit point of Act SH 2972 only; tax years 2023 and 2021 and earlier, and the 2022 base, declined by name with the missing source named
tax_years_answered.s 121B: tax year 2025 only, with the s 121B(a) amount supplied; tax years before 2025 declined by name; tax years from 2026 are row IL-03's

published_figures.note: No published figure is carried as data. 721,560 is used in tests only, as a labelled scenario value taken from the consolidation's editorial note on s 121B(a); it is not law and no rule reads it.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the sources, and no independent test pass has been run yet. Every expected value in this encoder's tests was worked by hand from the Hebrew, with the arithmetic beside it, before it was asserted; a control copy with four values made wrong reported four failures. Differentials were run against rows IL-02 (132 of 132 agree) and IL-03 (22 of 22 agree), as recorded in NOTES.md section 6, Controls.
